decision.diagnostic: Report configured limits and observed load as a read-only advisory; never edit local.conf or the environment.
decision.parallelism: Do not multiply BB_NUMBER_THREADS by PARALLEL_MAKE because BitBake task concurrency and per-task make concurrency overlap dynamically.
decision.default: Retain the user's build configuration, inherited scheduler, full affinity, and cgroup policy.
decision.example: When interaction is poor, one fewer job than available logical CPUs is an optional review example, not an automatic default.
decision.correctness: Yoctui remains correct without root, affinity isolation, cgroup overrides, or a deliberately free logical CPU.
